azureVmUtils.notes: Other versions or distributions are manual status. Source tag v0.7.0 is pinned in backends.json for review only and is never built by the toolkit.

manaLinux.reason: Support depends on the distribution kernel build and backports; kernel upgrades are not automated and kernel version alone is not used as proof.

manaWindows.reason: The entry point is a mutable redirect with no published hash policy. The operator downloads, reviews and binds a zip SHA256; the guest verifies hash, Authenticode (Microsoft signer) and exactly one INF matching PCI VEN_1414&DEV_00BA.

limits.reboot: Separate consent; restart only (no deallocate, resize or start-stop sequence).
